{{Top|leg}}
'''Phasers''' were a type of [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]]. Phaser was an acronym for '''P'''erpetually '''H'''eat-'''A'''ctivated '''S'''onic-'''E'''mmitted '''R'''ay. They differed from the usual "laser" weapons in that they did not rapidly shoot out gas-induced plasma beams, but instead shot long beams of pure radio-active heat-light rays activated by a special type of sonic conductor. Bounty hunters often preferred to use them as sniper rifles because they were lighter weight than plasma-beam sniper rifles and a lot easier to handle, but finding one was very difficult. Phaser weapons were exceedingly rare and worth a lot of money as relics.<ref name="Boba">''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]''</ref>
